items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17

ctx.x: All the Creole. All the. Brother Cornbread. His name is Joseph Thomas, but they call him.

Thomas. That's right. Albert Thomas. Yeah, yeah. George Thomas. George Thomas. George Thomas. He's the one that sings all the Creole songs. Yeah. He's old. And so they have a beautiful, wonderful band. Oh. And they played all the old pieces. This is funny.

You know, recently they said about the old musicians, they didn't have very many left. But you would be surprised how many they do have left that no one. I know quite a few right around here. Oh yeah. And I bet there's a lot still that you don't know that has valuable information. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. That's right. They're living. They're very old, but they're here.
